//: Papercusp worker hooks as a Claude plugin (papercusp-worker-integration-2026-06-04, D-005). These reference the worker hook scripts at their stable installed location (~/.papercusp/hooks/cc/, populated by install-standalone-mcp.sh) — the plugin is a thin wiring convenience over the installed worker, NOT a standalone bundle (the scripts need a running operator + ~/.papercusp). All hooks self-gate on PAPERCUSP_SID + fail open. The activity-report hook is the cross-CLI activity bridge.
